meaning: Recorded losses of A0 against its competitor set, per kernel and axis (tools/loss-ledger.ts). A loss is a competitor ahead of A0 by more than the tie band (`noise`). The ledger can only shrink: `bun run loss-ledger` fails on a new loss or a loss worse than `gap + noise`; `--update --reason` is the one way to grow it. `unverified` entries were recorded above load 10 (or with no load recorded) and are not trusted either way.

history.reason: initial ledger from the recorded results
